scope: Original 2020 Dune: Imperium base/core standard 2-4-player multiplayer, including mandatory two-player House Hagal. Solo, optional variants, expansions, promos and Uprising excluded.
assessment: Every material gameplay claim has positive support in the identified authoritative sources. No material contradiction, incorrect timing, destination, cost, exception, end condition, edition mixing or important gameplay omission found. Card art was inspected rather than inferred from absent extracted text.

checked_claims.claim: Deck-building worker placement; four Factions; VP objective; end-of-round 10 VP or exhausted Conflict deck; two Leader abilities and Signet timing; cards override ordinary rules; original base multiplayer scope with required two-player Rival.
source_references: Rulebook pp. 2, 6-8, 13, 19

checked_claims.claim: All listed component counts, denominations, player components and identical ten-card starting-deck composition.

checked_claims.claim: Board/Mentat/Alliances setup; independently shuffled Conflict tiers ordered 1 I, 5 II, all 4 III; unused cards returned unseen.

checked_claims.claim: Intrigue and Imperium decks face down; five-card face-up Row; three separate Reserve stacks.

checked_claims.claim: 4-player score starts at 1, other multiplayer at 0; Combat marker at 0; bottom Influence cubes, three garrison troops, rest visible supply; one water each; unlimited resource bank; random First Player marker; additional Hagal setup.

checked_claims.claim: Five phases in order; reveal Conflict on prior cards, then draw five for round.

checked_claims.claim: Clockwise individual turns; Agent or Reveal, early Reveal allowed, no turns after Reveal, phase ends after all Reveal; Plot cards during own turns.

checked_claims.claim: One hand card, one matching icon and one available Agent to an unoccupied space; no-icon cards cannot be used normally as Agent cards; pay entry costs and meet requirements before effects; resolve space, Agent box and Faction Influence in any order; ignore Reveal box. Seven icon categories and Sardaukar Legion example.

checked_claims.claim: Arrow cost precedes effect, optional once per arrow; entry costs mandatory; Intrigue costs and conditions mandatory; normal effects mandatory except may, optional arrow and optional black-X trash; cost-based trash and non-arrow self-trash mandatory.

checked_claims.claim: Recruit from supply, normally into garrison; supply exhaustion; Combat-space deployment allows current-turn recruits from all sources plus up to two previously garrisoned troops; no re-recruit workaround.

checked_claims.claim: Reveal steps ordered reveal hand, resolve Reveal boxes, set strength, discard in-play cards; any order for Reveal effects and acquisitions; no Agent-box reuse; two per deployed troop, one per sword, no deployed troop means zero strength, over-20 marker handling.

checked_claims.claim: Cards drawn during Reveal immediately revealed/used; cards drawn after Reveal retained into next round plus five new cards; no conversion back to Agent turn.

checked_claims.claim: Sardaukar Legion Reveal deploys up to three garrison troops before strength is set, despite no general Reveal deployment step.

checked_claims.claim: Combat Intrigue clockwise from First Player only with troops; any number or pass; consecutive passes end play, prior pass not binding; adjust Combat markers; win-trigger cards after victory before next phase.

checked_claims.claim: Rank rewards; ordinary third reward only with four players; zero strength none; ties first use second and have no winner, second use third even in 2/3-player play, third none; troops return to supply and markers zero.
